The '''CFC-100''' was a corporate watcher [[Computer/Legends|computer]] manufactured by [[CoreDataFiles]]. It was used by businessmen to keep track of the actions of corporations in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and provided financial tracking data on over 10,000 business conglomerates including the [[Galaxy 500]], [[Surnack's Sentinel 100]], and the [[Tradoc Core Index]]. The computer's core package included a service contract with the [[Bank of the Core/Legends|Bank of the Core's]] [[Investment Division]].
